summary: KLX Energy Services filed an 8-K reporting the September 23, 2026 expiration of its previously announced subscription rights offering, with preliminary results disclosed in an attached press release, alongside a Regulation FD business update narrowing Q3 2026 revenue guidance and setting an Adjusted EBITDA margin range of 13% to 14%. No price per share, subscription level, premium, advisor, or closing date is stated in the excerpt; full results follow in November 2026. Watch for the final subscription percentage, backstop or standby purchasers, and any unsubscribed shares that could overhang the Nasdaq-listed common stock.
